vendors.name: SquadStack
vendors.target: Consumer brands and BFSI sales teams; '60+ consumer brands' incl. Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndiaMART, Flipkart, Swiggy

per_minute_from.notes: Homepage FAQ: voice AI priced per minute, 'typically ₹2 to ₹5', with setup costs for enterprise deployments. Pricing page: billed only for live AI talk time, one-time setup fee per use case, quote after discovery call.

pricing.per_minute_scope: homepage FAQ range ₹2–5; quote after discovery

hindi_hinglish.evidence: Supports Hindi and code-mixed speech such as Hinglish and Taminglish with mid-sentence switching.

indic_languages.evidence: Nine languages: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali.

outbound_inbound.evidence: Outbound campaigns and lead outreach are the focus; inbound AI calling not described.

live_transfer.evidence: 'Complex conversations still warm-transfer to a human, by design'; human advisor pod handles handoffs.

mid_call_actions.evidence: Agents qualify leads, open accounts, book appointments and take payment commitments on the call.

no_code_builder.evidence: No self-serve builder; agents set up by a forward-deployed engineer; 'Control Tower' exposes 100+ configurations.

api_webhooks.evidence: Lead and workflow APIs: webhooks and JSON APIs, plus custom connectors.

built_in_crm.evidence: Offers 'Lead Management & Omnichannel Outreach' / AI Lead Manager; pipeline features not detailed. Two-way sync with Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot.

lead_source_connectors.evidence: Leads arrive via webhooks, JSON APIs and third-party connectors built per client; no native Meta/Google lead-ad connector named.

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Call, WhatsApp, SMS and in-app channels share context for follow-ups.

post_call_analysis.evidence: Reporting, analytics and voice-of-customer insights; per-call summary/disposition fields not explicitly described.

call_qa.evidence: 'AI plus human quality audits across 23 parameters'; QA page doesn't say AI-agent calls are scored.

human_call_intelligence.evidence: AI Call Quality Analysis scores agent calls on 23 quality parameters with transcripts.

telephony_included.evidence: Dialer included in price; multi-operator routing over Exotel, Knowlarity, Ozonetel, Gupshup with failover.

vendors.languages: 9 languages: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali; code-mixed Hinglish/Taminglish
